description: Comment standards for code that AI agents mostly write and read, without a language set: the code-docs rule (the guard floor, where each clause of a comment goes, record pointers and process IDs, doc text that renders into help and schemas, the length caps with their per-file ratchet, and the five standard-library check scripts it ships) and the code-docs-cleanup skill that shortens existing comments while proving every guard keeps its reason.
name: code-docs-essentials
summary: The code-comments set, the code-docs rule and the code-docs-cleanup skill, for any language
